explanation: Compared against OEIS A228623 (Zhi-Wei Sun): 'Determinant of the n X n matrix with (i,j)-entry (i,j = 0,...,n-1) equal to 1 or 0 according as n + i - j and n - i + j are both prime or not', with 'Conjecture: a(n) is nonzero if n is odd and greater than 120.' In Lean the matrix entry over Fin n is 1 iff n + i − j and n + j − i are both prime (the natural subtractions are exact since i, j < n), a n is its determinant in ℤ, and tests match the data (0, 1, 1, 1, 0, −1). The statement a n ≠ 0 for odd n > 120 is the conjecture. Faithful.
